verdict.rationale: Gemini's support docs state that Gemini Apps can personalize responses based on "the memory of your past Gemini chats" [gemini-docs-18], which directly matches the story. Notebooks add a continuous chat that remembers sources, instructions and ongoing discussions within a project space [gemini-docs-11]. Missing for 10: detail on how remembered context is retrieved and applied in new chats, documented controls for viewing or editing stored memories, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
